title: EZDox Configuration
description: Schema for EZDox project configuration files (EZDox.yaml, EZDox.json, EZDox.toml).

project.description: Project name displayed in generated documentation.

sources.description: Source directories or files to scan for docstrings.

frontpage.description: Path to a Markdown file used as the documentation front page.

manual.description: Path to a directory of manual Markdown chapters.

includes.description: Include directories for the source scanner.

excludes.description: Glob patterns or directories to exclude from scanning.

targets.description: Output targets to generate (HTML, LaTeX, Manpage, ROFF, XML).

markups.description: Markup parsers to use (Markdown, ReStructuredText, Docbook, XWiki).

commands.description: Named shell commands that can be executed via ezdox-cli run.

pipelines.description: Named pipelines composed of commands executed in sequence.

environment.description: Environment variables set when running commands/pipelines.

template.description: Path to a custom template directory for HTML/LaTeX output.

doxygen_compat.description: Enable Doxygen command recognition during parsing.

defines.description: Preprocessor definitions passed to the scanner.
